title: Baba ke Shehr May
body:
zahra ghareeb hogayi baba ke shehr may
ghut ghut ke zindagi kati baba ke shehr may
<<DIVIDER>>
is dar ki manzilat se to shahid hai khud khuda
be-izn jibraeel bhi daakhil nahi hua
us dar pe aag dekhli baba ke shehr may
zahra ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne nabi ki beti ko haq na diya gaya
haq ki gawahi dene ko koi nahi mila
zahra pukarti rahi baba ke shehr may
zahra ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai fatema ke waaste mehshar se kam nahi
haathon may murtaza ke hai rassiyan bandhi hui
ghurbat ali ki dekhli baba ke shehr may
zahra ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke gham may baap ke jaati rahi nazar
athara saal may hui kham aap ki kamar
kitni zaeefa hogayi baba ke shehr may
zahra ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ho bayan kis tarha ummul hussain ka
kaafi hai rone ke liye alvi yehi sada
beti tadap ke mar gayi baba ke shehr may
zahra ghareeb hogayi...
author: Ali Mohammad Alvi
